title: Atomic Types
summary: Thread-safe primitive types that support atomic operations without mutexes.
lecture: Atomic types like `AtomicBool`, `AtomicI32`, and `AtomicUsize` provide thread-safe interior mutability.
They allow concurrent modification through shared references without needing a `Mutex`.
Every operation on an atomic type requires an explicit memory ordering parameter.

example.caption: fetch_add mutates the value through &AtomicI32.
